text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- Debounce input; cache results per query
- Abort the previous request; ignore
  replies that are not the latest query
- Combobox + listbox roles, arrow keys,
  Enter, Escape, live region count
- Highlight the match safely (no innerHTML)
- Props: fetcher, minChars, debounceMs,
  renderItem, onSelect
